openapi.authDesc: Secret is shown only at creation and stored encrypted

openapi.asyncDeliveryDesc: Supplier purchases enter the encrypted notification Outbox when complete

openapi.endpointBalance: Read the real balance snapshot of the billing account bound to the current credential
openapi.docEnvironmentHint: This address is taken live from the current admin API configuration; no manual rewriting of the site domain is needed when copying to a test or production environment.
openapi.docSignatureTimestamp: X-Timestamp uses Unix seconds; 300 seconds in the past and 60 seconds in the future are allowed, so the integrating server must keep its clock synchronized.
openapi.docSignatureNonce: X-Nonce must be 16–128 characters long and must not be reused within 360 seconds per credential; generate a new value for every HTTP attempt.
openapi.docSignaturePath: METHOD is uppercase; path takes only the URL pathname (including /openapi/v1), excluding the protocol, domain, and query.
openapi.docSignatureBody: Compute lowercase SHA-256 hex over the raw bytes of the body actually sent; GET uses an empty byte body, and both JSON whitespace and key order affect the digest.
openapi.docSignatureOutput: Compute HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical string using the API Secret, and send the lowercase hex result as X-Signature.
openapi.docNonceRetryWarning: Network retries must keep the same client_order_no and the exact same business payload, but regenerate the timestamp, nonce, and signature; do not reuse the previous authorization header.
openapi.docCatalogTitle: Product catalog and dynamic order fields
openapi.docCatalogSub: Read the live catalog first, then generate the collection UI and order parameters from input_fields
openapi.docInputFieldsSource: Only use the enabled fields returned by this GET /products call; key is a stable semantic identifier, while id is used for the field-ID mode.
openapi.docInputFieldsTypes: input_type supports text, email, number, select, and textarea; select values must come exactly from options.
openapi.docInputFieldsValidation: Validation runs required, Unicode character length, type, and validation_pattern (full RE2 match) at the same time.
openapi.docInputFieldsSensitive: Sensitive fields must not be written into application logs, monitoring labels, URLs, or error messages; LinLinQi encrypts them at rest.
openapi.docVariantIdentity: When a variant exists, prefer submitting the variant's external_id directly; you may also submit the product external_id together with variant_id. Never cache or guess UUIDs yourself.
openapi.docCreateSub: The request body participates in signing; fix the raw JSON bytes first, then compute the digest and send that same body
openapi.docInputModeAria: Select the dynamic field submission mode
openapi.docOrderProduct: external_product_id uses the product or variant external_id returned by the catalog; quantity allows 1–20.
openapi.docOrderRequired: email and client_order_no are required; payment_method currently supports only supplier_balance.
openapi.docOrderInputs: parameters are submitted by stable key; input_values are submitted by field_id. Unknown, duplicated, missing, or validation-failed fields return 42222.
openapi.docOrderCallback: callback_url is optional; when enabled, it must be a publicly accessible HTTPS address and pass DNS, private-network, and redirect security checks.
openapi.docOrderStrict: Requests use strict JSON: unknown fields, trailing content, and wrong types are all rejected. Amount fields uniformly use integer cents.
openapi.docCreateCurl: Executable signing example · run after replacing the placeholders
openapi.docInputModeRule: Both dynamic field formats can be used in the same order, but a field must not be duplicated across parameters and input_values; sensitive values exist only in the signed body — do not print BODY to logs.
openapi.docIdempotencySub: POST returns 201; GET /orders/{order_no} returns 200 and can only query orders created with the current credential
openapi.docIdempotencyExact: client_order_no is unique within the same credential; if the product, variant, quantity, email, payment method, callback address, and dynamic fields are exactly the same, the original order is returned without a duplicate charge.
openapi.docIdempotencyConflict: Reusing client_order_no with any different protected field returns 40921; you must stop retrying and check manually — do not change the order number to mask the conflict.
openapi.docIdempotencyTransport: On timeout or connection loss, retry with the original client_order_no and business body and generate a new authorization header; you may also poll the order with external_order_no.
openapi.docDeliveryStatus: deliveries returns content only for delivered or completed; other statuses keep an empty array and keep polling — do not treat unknown statuses as failures.
openapi.docMoneyUnit: Amounts such as cost and price are all in RMB cents; never use floats to convert or transmit accounting amounts.
openapi.docCallbackSub: When callback_url is enabled, only order.delivered is pushed; order lookup always remains the final fallback
openapi.docCallbackHeaders: Read X-LinLinQi-Timestamp and X-LinLinQi-Signature; the Secret is the same API Secret used when creating the order.
openapi.docCallbackVerify: Keep raw_body before reading and parsing the JSON, compute HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + '.' + raw_body, and compare using constant-time comparison.
openapi.docCallbackIdempotent: After verifying the time window, create a unique constraint on event_id; duplicate deliveries return success directly and must not double-post or double-ship.
openapi.docCallbackAck: Return any 2xx only after the business event is safely persisted; non-2xx, timeout, or network errors are all treated as failures.
openapi.docCallbackRetry: On failure, delivery is attempted at most 12 times with exponential backoff from about 2 to 256 seconds; after consecutive failures reach the threshold the endpoint is disabled automatically, and a success resets the failure count.
openapi.docCallbackFallback: A delayed or terminated callback does not change the order facts; compensate by polling GET /orders/{external_order_no} on a schedule.
openapi.docErrorsSub: HTTP status drives transport decisions, code drives stable business branching, and message is for display only and is localized
openapi.docErrorAuth: Timestamp, credential, signature, or Nonce format is invalid
openapi.docErrorAuthAction: Synchronize the clock and verify the canonical/raw body; after fixing, re-sign with a new nonce, and stop requesting when the credential is invalid.
openapi.docErrorBalance: Insufficient balance in the supply account
openapi.docErrorBalanceAction: Stop automatic retries; top up or, after operations confirms the balance, resubmit the same business order number.
openapi.docErrorPermission: The credential lacks permission for the current endpoint
openapi.docErrorPermissionAction: Stop retrying and have an administrator review products:read, orders:write, or orders:read.
openapi.docErrorNotFound: The order does not exist under the current credential
openapi.docErrorNotFoundAction: Verify the external_order_no and the creating credential; do not query across credentials.
openapi.docErrorStockAction: Refresh the product catalog; do not retry without a gap or assume stale stock is still valid.
openapi.docErrorNonce: The Nonce has already been used within the 360-second anti-replay window
openapi.docErrorNonceAction: Keep the business payload unchanged, generate a new timestamp, nonce, and signature, then retry.
openapi.docErrorIdempotency: client_order_no has been reused by different order content
openapi.docErrorIdempotencyAction: Stop immediately and verify the local order; after correcting the order-number mapping or request content, let a human decide.
openapi.docErrorValidation: Required fields, the callback URL, or dynamic fields failed validation
openapi.docErrorValidationAction: Fix the request per the latest catalog and do not auto-retry unchanged; re-collect user fields when necessary.
openapi.docErrorReplayService: The Redis anti-replay service is unavailable; the server fails closed
openapi.docErrorRetryAction: Use exponential backoff with random jitter; keep client_order_no, use a fresh authorization header, and set a maximum number of attempts.
openapi.docErrorServer: A server error occurred while processing the order or delivery content
openapi.docRetryPolicy: Apply bounded exponential backoff only to 503, some 500s, and network failures; 401/402/403/40921/422 must first have their cause resolved. Use a new Nonce on every retry, but never change client_order_no to sidestep an idempotency conflict.
